data.name: Delip
data.gender_notes: Delip is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Sanskrit ‘dīp’ meaning a lamp, light or clarity. It signifies the light of knowledge, wisdom and understanding. In Hindu mythology, Delip is a name of Lord Krishna, symbolizing the illuminating power of divine love. The name Delip carries the meaning “Light, Clear, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Delip usually hope their child will grow to embody light, clear, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies the light of spiritual wisdom and knowledge.
data.etymology: Delip belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light, Clear, Radiant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Delip total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: The name Delip holds a rich cultural significance in the Hindu tradition, reflecting the values of knowledge, wisdom and understanding. The Sanskrit origin of the name 'dīp' signifying a lamp or light, represents the power of knowledge that illuminates our path and dispels darkness. In everyday life, the name embodies the qualities of being a beacon of guidance, trust and infallible illumination for others. It also highlights the importance of education and intellectual pursuits, which have been revered in Indian culture since ancient times.
data.spiritual_significance: Delip is a name deeply rooted in spirituality, symbolizing the presence of the divine light that is the source of all knowledge and wisdom. The name resonates with the spiritual significance of Lord Krishna, who is referred to as 'Delip-sura', the lion among the divine lights. Lord Krishna is celebrated for his role as the illuminator of minds and the remover of all shadows of ignorance, bestowing the light of wisdom upon his devotees. The name Delip is a constant reminder of the spiritual journey towards self-realization and ultimate union with the divine source of light and knowledge.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Delip: Radiant, shining with inner light and joy. A name that embodies the pure and illumined soul.
